Three people were killed and one was injured at an Ohio baby shower during an apparent domestic dispute, authorities said.
Officers responded to a shooting on Saturday evening at Pandora’s Magical Events Venue in Parma, about 16km (10 miles) south of Cleveland, a police news release said.
